about: Rythmodan (disopyramide), by brand name only, is supplied nine times from January to September 2026 to a 67-year-old man.

Quinidine sulfate, which has no Australian brand and appears by ingredient name, is supplied three times from December 2025 to February 2026 to a 71-year-old woman, in the middle of a 14-month history.

Accupril (quinapril), a blood pressure medicine whose name resembles quinidine, and Minax (metoprolol), a beta-blocker, are supplied throughout, and quinidine, procainamide and disopyramide are never supplied, so the criterion is not met.
